title: Inforsight conservation action
description: Versioned JSON Schema contract defining allowed policy conservation interventions, cost-resource parameters, and channel constraints.

action_id.description: Unique identifier for this action specification.

channel.description: Operational communication channel used to deliver the intervention.

direct_cost_usd.description: Direct financial expense c(a) in USD required to execute the action.

personnel_hours.description: Required staff personnel hours to execute the action.

regulatory_cooling_off_days.description: Mandatory minimum calendar days required before re-contacting the policyholder.

minimum_policy_tenure_days.description: Minimum policy age in days required to be eligible for this action.

maximum_policy_tenure_days.description: Optional maximum policy age in days; null if unbounded.

requires_grace_period.description: Whether this action strictly requires the policy to be in active grace period.
